responsibility: Supplies GCC’s implementation of <stddef.h>, including guarded definitions of ptrdiff_t, size_t, wchar_t, wint_t, NULL, offsetof, max_align_t, and newer nullptr_t/unreachable additions, while handling the many __need_* partial-definition entry points and system-header guard conventions needed to coexist with host libc headers. This file is the central common-types compatibility header that exposes front-end predefined type macros such as __SIZE_TYPE__, __PTRDIFF_TYPE__, and __WCHAR_TYPE__ as standard source-visible typedefs and constants.
